excerpt.en: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the [target.GetName] that would be susceptible to our assistance.

texts.zh: 我们的特工正在甄别并试图同[target.GetName]国内的犯罪团伙接触，他们很容易被我们的援助影响到。
texts.en: Our operatives are working to identify and make contact with criminal elements inside the [target.GetName] that would be susceptible to our assistance.

label.zh: 下一阶段（上一阶段的难度检定通过后）
label.en: Next stage (once the previous stage's difficulty check is passed)

texts.zh:
那些我们用于针对[target_country.GetName]的私掠船队已经切断了同我们的联系，并且通过其他地方运输的资源继续破坏。

我们没法探明是什么势力在背后暗流涌动，但是看来他们和我们的目的一致。我方自己的行动在这里唐突地中止了，但我们依然收到报告，[target_country.GetAdj]的航道如同我们计划的那样被打乱了。
texts.en:
The privateers we were working with in the [target_country.GetName] have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.

We cannot identify whoever is behind this effort, but it seems they shared our goals. Our own operation ends abruptly here, but reports indicate the [target_country.GetAdj] shipping lanes are being disrupted all the same.

texts.zh:
我们提供武器和船只的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经切断了同我们的联系，开始接触其他人以获取资源并继续掠夺。

我们没法探明是什么势力在背后暗流涌动，但是看来他们和我们的目的一致。我方自己的行动在这里唐突地中止了，但我们依然收到报告，[target_country.GetAdj]的航道如同我们计划的那样被打乱了。
texts.en:
The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have cut ties with us, and have begun wreaking havoc using materiel from some other source.

We cannot identify whoever is behind this effort, but it seems they shared our goals. Our own operation ends abruptly here, but reports indicate the [target_country.GetAdj] shipping lanes are being disrupted all the same.

texts.zh: 我们同一群虽然聒噪，但是很能打的[target.GetSpeciesName]海盗接上了头。这群暴力的亡命徒很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
texts.en: We have made contact with a rowdy but promising group of [target.GetSpeciesName] pirates. These violent cutthroats are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

texts.zh: 我们同一小群脱离了[target.GetName]中央智能的故障单位接上了头。这些高度不稳定且难以预测的[target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
texts.en: We have made contact with a small group of malfunctioning units who have isolated themselves from the central intelligence of the [target.GetName]. These highly unstable and unpredictable [target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

texts.zh: 我们同一小群拥有罕见基因突变、可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连结而不会陷入休眠的子个体接上了头。这些暴力且难以预测的突变[target.GetGestaltEntityName]很乐意接受我们的武备和舰船，不过一旦放跑之后我们就没办法控制他们了。
texts.en: We have established contact with a small group of mutated outcasts who have somehow managed to sever their link to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without perishing. These violent and unpredictable mutants are more than willing to accept our weapons and ships, although we'll have no way of controlling them once they're set loose.

label.zh: 下一阶段（上一阶段的难度检定通过后）
label.en: Next stage (once the previous stage's difficulty check is passed)

texts.zh: 货运武器和抹除标记的舰船由我方特工负责走私进入[target.GetName]，并确保不会追溯到我们身上。我们已经准备好将它们交付给海盗了。
texts.en: Weapon shipments and unmarked ships that can't be traced back to us have been smuggled into the [target.GetName] by our operatives. We are ready to hand them over to the privateers.

texts.zh: 被我们武装起来的海盗已经在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟，他们立马就开始针对当地的货运船只。我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。
texts.en: The privateers we armed have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system, and they have immediately begun targeting local shipping. Our analysts expect that the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within their borders.

texts.zh: 在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群流亡的[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们立马将恒星系内一切不属于他们的东西视为威胁，我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]很快就会分兵处理这股不稳定的势力。
texts.en: The rogue [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system. They are designating everything in the system that does not belong to them as a threat, and our analysts expect that the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing element.

texts.zh: 在我们资助舰船和武器后，一群[target_country.GetSpeciesName]的变异体在[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系站稳了脚跟。他们从此地出发，开始捕食一切触及范围内的资源和养分，我们的分析师期望[target_country.GetName]的中央蜂巢意识很快就会分兵处理这股国境内的不稳定威胁。
texts.en: The [target_country.GetSpeciesName] mutants that we supplied with ships and weapons have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system. From there they are preying on everything within their reach in their struggle for resources and nutrients. Our analysts expect that the central hive consciousness of the [target_country.GetName] will soon have to divert forces to deal with this destabilizing threat within its borders.

texts.zh: 一支高度武装的私掠船队出现在了[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系！和其他海盗没什么区别，这群乌合之众立马开始针对我们通过这个恒星系的货运船只。我们的情报部门高度怀疑他们收到了境外势力资助的舰船和武器。
texts.en: A group of heavily armed privateers has established a presence in the [privateer_system.GetName] system! Little more than pirates, these lowlifes have immediately begun targeting our shipping passing through the system. Intelligence strongly suspects that they were supplied with ships and weapons by an outside power.

texts.zh: 一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系！这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用境外势力资助的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
texts.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [privateer_system.GetName] system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft supplied to them by a foreign power to raid everything in the system for spare parts and resources.

texts.zh: 一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]，可使它们切断与[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的影响范围太远，这些离群的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内[privateer_system.GetName]恒星系。它们使用的武器和舰船一定是来自于某个境外势力！
texts.en: A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the [target.GetGestaltEntityName] without being rendered comatose. As these rogue [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] would perish if they ventured too far from the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s influence, they have established themselves in the [privateer_system.GetName] system within our borders. The weapons and ships they are using must have been supplied by a foreign power!

summary.text:
# 尝试联络 / Making Contact

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:777-829`; `events/nemesis_operations_events_2.txt`
- DLC：Nemesis
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动 operation_arm_privateers（武装私掠）：成本影响力180，维持能量12，间谍力60，三个难度 T6 的阶段；目标是默认国家且尚未被这个行动盯上（target_of_operation_arm_privateers）；同时只能进行一个行动。

The operation operation_arm_privateers ("Arm Privateers"): cost 180 influence, upkeep 12 energy, spy power 60, three tier-6 stages; the target is a default country not yet targeted by this operation (target_of_operation_arm_privateers); one operation at a time.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

6200“尝试联络”→ 6201“联络建立”→ 6202“物资送达”（选“开始行动”）→ 隐藏 6204 → 6205“私掠者出没”（给执行者）与 6206“……星系出现敌对者！”（给目标）。若目标已被别人武装过，各阶段会改走 6207“私掠者已被牵涉”。

6200 "Making Contact" -> 6201 "Contact Established" -> 6202 "Shipments Made" (choose "Commence Operation!") -> hidden 6204 -> 6205 "Privateers Active" (to the performer) and 6206 "Hostiles in ..." (to the target). If the target was already armed by someone else the stages divert to 6207 "Privateers Already Engaged".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

6205/6206（成功）与 6207（目标已被武装）互斥。

6205/6206 (success) and 6207 (target already armed) are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了行动与 6200–6207 的分流条件。

The operation and the divert conditions of 6200-6207 were checked.
